items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: He was playing in Sonny Rollins' band.

ctx.x: Jim Hall. See but he was playing with a black man. He was playing in Sonny Rollins' band. So that's how he got his name, by playing with Sonny Rollins, you see. He was a fine guitar player but he wasn't that fine, at the time, you see. So they had to write about those people so they could make room for these Superstars to play out here man. You're talking too much about the Messengers. You're talking too much about the great Miles Davis. See Miles Davis had everything sewed up, you know. His band was a rare type.…
